mapper.update: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS h_dict_base ( dict_name VARCHAR(200) PRIMARY KEY, dict_desc VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, dict_source INTEGER default 1, key_column VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'key', val_column VARCHAR(10) DEFAULT 'val', app VARCHAR(200) DEFAULT 'common' )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS h_dict_pairs ( dict_name VARCHAR(200), pair_key VARCHAR(255), pair_value VARCHAR(2000), PRIMARY KEY (dict_name, pair_key) )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS h_dict_sql ( dict_name VARCHAR(200) PRIMARY KEY, sql_content VARCHAR(500) )
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS h_dict_sql_county ( c_key VARCHAR(50) PRIMARY KEY, c_name VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL )
